summary: Negative event weights could be dropped in training, and the metric layer passed signed-weight metrics outside [0, 1], truncated fractional labels to 0 and accepted invalid Asimov inputs.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the first release of train_classifier.py --negative-weights dropped and of the metric layer

observables: classifier trained with negative event weights
weighted AUC, efficiencies and ROC points
impact.bias: dropping negative weights biases training and evaluation; signed-weight AUCs and efficiencies outside [0, 1] were printed without a flag; a fractional label became class 0; asimov_significance accepted a NaN or negative sigma_b and lost precision at s/b < 1e-6
impact.trigger: event weights with negative entries (NLO generators) with --negative-weights dropped, signed-weight metrics, labels that are not exactly 0 or 1, or a significance with a non-finite or negative sigma_b or s/b below 1e-6

remedy: retrain with --negative-weights signed, abs (bias recorded) or resample, and recompute the weighted metrics and significances with a release that has the fix
